text.p: Princess Margareta, the oldest daughter of exiled former Romanian king Michael, was married on Saturday to Romanian actor Radu Duda, Swiss media reported.
The couple's engagement was announced in June. Margareta lives in the Swiss town of Versoix, Switzerland, near Geneva.
Princess Margareta, 47, is eldest of five daughters of ex-king Michael. Michael has generally been barred from entering Romania since he was forced to abdicate in a 1947.

He was allowed back for a visit in 1992 for Orthodox Easter, but has been barred again since October 1994 by Ion Iliescu's leftist government. The government says it will not let him into the country until he recognises the post-Communist Republican constitution.
Margareta and her mother Ana are allowed into Romania for charitable work.
The ceremony was planned for St Gherassimos church, the same in which Margareta was baptised.
The couple met at a charity performance for a Bucharest orphanage and reportedly fell in love at the funeral of opposition leader and political prisoner Corneliu Coposu last November.
